test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person bought 80 pens at the rate of Rs. 80 per pen. He sells 40 pens at a loss of 20 per cent. If a profit of 20 per cent is earned on the all pens together, then what will be the profit percentage on the remaining 40 pens?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of pens bought = 80

Cost price of each pen = Rs. 80

Number of pens sold at a loss = 40

Loss percentage = 20%

Profit percentage on all pens = 20%

**Formula:**

Selling price (S.P.) = Cost price (C.P.) × (100% + Profit %)/100

Selling price (S.P.) = Cost price (C.P.) × (100% - Loss %)/100

Profit/Loss = Selling Price (S.P.) - Cost Price (C.P.)

**Solution:**

Cost price of 80 pens = 80 × 80 = Rs. 6400

Cost price of 4
